text: Episode fourteen. Who can see it, and who can come. Two different questions, and Revel asks them separately. Seen by the organizer, an outsider, and a member.

Every event has two dials. Visibility is who can find the page: everyone, people with the link, or only members. Event type is who is allowed in: anyone, invited people, or members. They are set independently. This members' night is public to see, and members-only to attend.
Bea isn't a member. On the choir's page she sees the open rehearsal and the members' night, because both are public. The committee meeting isn't on her list at all.
She can open the members' night, but she can't R S V P. The page says why, and offers the way in: join the choir.
Lena is a member. She sees all three, committee meeting included.
And for her, the members' night just works. She says yes, and she's in. No gate, no request, nothing to explain.
Visible isn't the same as open, and you get to choose both. Revel is free and open source. Find it at lets revel dot io.
